frontmatter.title: Monitoring Hotel Prices with WebMonitor.fyi
frontmatter.description: Discover how to use WebMonitor.fyi to track hotel price changes and availability. Get instant alerts when prices drop or rooms become available at your favorite hotels.
frontmatter.author: Alex Morgan

post.content:
## Introduction

Finding the best hotel deals can significantly reduce your travel expenses and enhance your trip experience. Hotel prices can fluctuate due to various factors such as seasonality, demand, and promotional offers. Keeping track of these changes manually can be time-consuming and inefficient. With WebMonitor.fyi, you can automate the process of monitoring hotel prices and availability, ensuring you secure the best rates for your accommodations. In this guide, we'll show you how to set up monitoring for hotel prices and stay informed about the latest deals.


## Why Monitor Hotel Prices and Availability?

Monitoring hotel prices offers several benefits for travelers:



- Save Money: Catch price drops and take advantage of promotional rates to reduce your accommodation costs.

- Stay Informed: Be alerted when rooms become available at fully booked hotels or when new offers are introduced.

- Plan Flexibly: Monitor multiple hotels or room types to choose the option that best fits your preferences and budget.




## How WebMonitor.fyi Can Help

WebMonitor.fyi leverages AI technology to monitor web content intelligently. Here's how it assists you with tracking hotel prices:



- Automated Monitoring: Continuously checks hotel booking pages for price changes and availability updates.

- Custom Criteria: Use natural language to define what changes you want to be notified about.

- Instant Notifications: Receive real-time alerts via email when your specified conditions are met.




## Step-by-Step Guide to Monitoring Hotel Prices


### Step 1: Find the Hotel Booking Page URL

Visit the website of the hotel or booking platform (such as Booking.com, Expedia, or the hotel's official site) and navigate to the page of the hotel you're interested in. Select your desired dates and room preferences, then copy the URL from your browser's address bar.


### Step 2: Log In to WebMonitor.fyi

Access your WebMonitor.fyi account. If you don't have an account yet, sign up for free to get started.


### Step 3: Create a New Monitor

In your dashboard, click on "Add New Monitor". Paste the hotel booking page URL into the URL field provided.


### Step 4: Set Your Monitoring Criteria

In the criteria section, specify what you want to monitor using natural language. Examples include:



- "Notify me when the price per night drops below $150."

- "Alert me if a deluxe room becomes available."

- "Inform me when there's a free cancellation offer."

- "Notify me when any special promotions or discounts are added."



Our AI will understand your instructions and set up monitoring accordingly.


### Step 5: Choose Monitoring Frequency

Select how often you want WebMonitor.fyi to check the page. For dynamic pricing, a frequency of every few hours may be suitable.


### Step 6: Configure Notifications

Choose your preferred method for receiving alerts. Email notifications are enabled by default, but you can also opt for SMS or API notifications depending on your plan.


### Step 7: Save and Activate Your Monitor

Review your settings and click "Save" to activate the monitor. WebMonitor.fyi will now monitor the booking page based on your criteria and notify you of any changes.


## Tips for Effective Hotel Price Monitoring

Enhance your monitoring strategy with these tips:



- Monitor Multiple Hotels: Set up monitors for several hotels or booking platforms to compare prices and availability.

- Flexible Dates: If your travel dates are flexible, monitor different date ranges to find the best rates.

- Special Requests: Use custom criteria to monitor for rooms with specific amenities, such as sea views or complimentary breakfast.

- Cancellation Policies: Keep an eye on changes to cancellation terms, which can offer greater booking flexibility.




## Conclusion

By utilizing WebMonitor.fyi, you can automate the process of tracking hotel prices and availability, saving you time and money. Set up monitors for your desired accommodations today and let our AI-powered platform keep you informed of the best deals and opportunities.
